note: Snapshot button. New clipboard icon in the header copies the last N bars of gauge state as an ASCII-table any AI can read. Header carries symbol interval active rule EMA periods gravity and ATR. Per-bar columns are OHLC plus temperature plus zone letter G Y R plus RSI plus MACD histogram plus delta-T plus indicator-price spread plus any signal that fired. Footer summarizes current temperature trajectory latest signal in window gravity distance and any active divergence. Click for 10 bars, shift-click for 20, alt-click for 5. Reads from existing globals, no telemetry, no auto-send, the user carries words between minds. window.tgSnapshot exposed for headless use.
